# Merlay 0.6.5

- **Obsidian 1.15** — Restored visual editing with the Pele renderer and preserved theme colors in SVG and PNG exports.
- **Safer Markdown saves** — Obsidian and VS Code keep saves tied to the original Mermaid block as surrounding lines move. If the block can no longer be identified safely, Merlay makes the unsaved source available for recovery.
- **VS Code** — Closing the visual editor keeps it closed while the source Markdown file stays open. The Markdown preview also uses the Merlay logo for the **Edit visually** button.
- **Documentation** — Clarified support for flowcharts, state diagrams, sequence diagrams, mindmaps, and class diagrams. Added a [known issues and workarounds guide](https://github.com/dev-hashemi/merlay/blob/0.6.5/docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md).

## Install

- **Obsidian** — Download `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css` from the release assets into `.obsidian/plugins/merlay/` in your vault, then enable Merlay in Community plugins.
- **VS Code** — Install from [Open VSX](https://open-vsx.org/extension/dev-hashemi/merlay) or use **Install from VSIX** with the attached package.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/dev-hashemi/merlay/compare/0.6.3...0.6.5)
